verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions an Atlas Dashboard for activating payments and tracking SAFEs, plus a registered agent. Nothing documents managing multiple entities or state registrations from one account, a received-documents inbox, or team or multi-user access. Community reports say state-level registration and legwork are left to the founder, which further undercuts the state-registration part of this story.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I manage all entities, state registrations, and received documents from one account my team can access
